idea: Build a bank-style CIP/CDD program for donors
argue_for: Uniform identity standard; comfort for partners.
argue_against: Sponsor is not a BSA FI (OB-32); nonprofit CDD duty sits on its bank; adds friction and PII.
existing_alternative: RR-UNB-PART-007-r1 applicability register; identity proofing for fraud.
reason_rejected: No legal basis; control objective (authorized actor, sanctions) achieved more cheaply.
revisit_if: Counsel finds a contractual CIP flow-down from a custodian/processor, or a vendor holding funds becomes an MSB.

idea: SAR filing module
argue_against: No SAR obligation for sponsor; OFAC blocking/reporting already modeled.
revisit_if: Operating model makes Unbound vendor a BSA FI.

idea: Automatic retries/dunning for failed contribution debits
argue_against: Donors owe nothing; retries raise unauthorized returns; Nacha limits.
revisit_if: Donors explicitly opt in to auto-retry.

idea: Instant payments (RTP/FedNow) as grant rail in release 1
argue_against: Irrevocable; charities rarely need seconds; BEC speed risk; receiving reach uncertain.
revisit_if: Sponsor demand plus receiving-bank coverage evidence.

idea: Platform-held FBO/omnibus account through Unbound vendor
argue_against: Triggers TPS/money transmission questions; Flipcause-type commingling risk.

idea: Contesting all card disputes
argue_against: Donor trust harm; costly for small gifts.

idea: ML cash forecasting model
argue_against: Disbursements are scheduled; deterministic projection suffices.

idea: Own card vault (store PAN) for recurring gifts
argue_against: Full PCI scope; breach exposure.
revisit_if: Never, unless a PCI-certified vault partner is used.

idea: Separate payments ledger in processor/bank adapter
argue_against: Violates single ledger writer; reconciliation duplication.

idea: Full event-sourced ledger where journals are projections re-derived from events
argue_against: Auditors test posted ledgers; code/policy changes would rewrite history.

idea: Fund-level money-weighted and time-weighted returns for every DAF
argue_against: Units already carry pool TWR; cost and confusion.
revisit_if: Sponsor sells SMA-heavy programs needing per-account performance.

idea: Native trade order management / rebalancer for pools run by external managers
argue_against: Duplicates OCIO/custodian; requires entitlements.

idea: General capital-gains tax-lot relief engine (FIFO/HIFO/min-tax)
argue_against: Sponsor pays no capital-gains tax.

idea: GIPS-compliant composite performance claims
argue_against: Not required; verification cost.

idea: Investor-style transfer-agency features for units (KYC on unitholders, 1099s, unit transfers)
argue_against: Unitholders are internal funds; no external investors.

idea: Real-time (intraday) NAV for pools
argue_against: Grants pay in days; daily forward NAV suffices.

idea: Auto-approval of audit adjustments by AI
argue_against: Accounting judgment and SoD.

idea: Build a native contact-center platform (ACD, telephony, dialer) in Unbound
argue_against: Commodity, regulated telephony; violates minimal infrastructure (UNB-TEC-002)

idea: Real-time supervisor barge/whisper and wallboards
argue_against: Presumes large agent pools; DAF volumes small
revisit_if: A sponsor runs >50 concurrent live agents

idea: Voice biometrics authentication
argue_against: Deepfake risk; biometric privacy law; consent burden
revisit_if: Mature liveness standards and counsel approval

idea: Sentiment-driven automatic goodwill credits or fee waivers
argue_against: Money movement on probabilistic signal; fee waivers need approval (WF-13)

idea: AI autonomous complaint closure
argue_against: Complaints need human judgment and accountability

idea: Per-agent AHT ranking/gamification
argue_against: Encourages rushing and cherry-picking; HWQ forbids raw-speed ranking

idea: Relational NPS as headline service KPI
argue_against: Low switching and infrequent contact make NPS a weak signal
revisit_if: Sponsor commercially needs NPS for board reporting (optional)

idea: Separate CRM, ticketing and case systems for contacts, cases, transactions and exceptions
argue_against: Duplicates state, splits audit; contrary to REQ-X-057

idea: One universal case lifecycle for all case kinds
argue_against: Couples clocks, access, holds (XIF-SVC-001)

idea: Outbound predictive dialing campaigns
argue_against: TCPA/consent exposure (unverified for charities); not a DAF need

idea: Per-grant claim reserves
argue_against: Grant amounts known; reservations exist (UNB-RCN-FIN-009)

idea: Mandatory external independent review organization for reconsideration
argue_against: Sponsor holds exclusive legal control; cost; not required

idea: Automated SIU scoring that auto-declines grants
argue_against: Auto-asserting fraud forbidden (EXC-16, UNB-GEX-033)

idea: Donor-visible accounting of every staff access (HIPAA 164.528 analog)
argue_against: Not required; reveals investigations; cost
revisit_if: Donor demand or privacy law requires

idea: Full legal matter management system
argue_against: Counsel uses own systems; small sponsors

idea: Native procurement and purchase orders
argue_against: Unrelated to fund administration; mature ERPs exist.
revisit_if: A sponsor contract makes it a condition and an owner decision approves.

idea: Native budgeting/forecasting
argue_against: Fund balances are not budgets.

idea: Native HR/payroll
argue_against: HRIS exists.

idea: Native operating accounts payable
argue_against: Mixing payees is the risk (XIF-ERP-004).
revisit_if: Sponsor without ERP in outsourced-admin model — then a separate module with its own entity.

idea: Full third-party risk management suite
argue_against: GRC tools exist.

idea: Native sales pipeline/opportunity management
argue_against: Donor acquisition is establishment intake; B2B sales is operator CRM.

idea: Customer 360 view across all capacities
argue_against: PII and conflict hazard.

idea: AI churn-prevention interventions inside transfer flows
argue_against: Obstructs donor's lawful request; sponsor decides transfers.

idea: Profitability-based service tiers that change grant processing speed
argue_against: Grant processing must not depend on fund profitability.
existing_alternative: Servicing model for optional services only.

idea: Household/relationship fee-tier aggregation by default
argue_against: Links funds and exposes data; DAF funds are separate arrangements.

idea: Automatic execution of letter-of-wishes intent
argue_against: Non-binding; sponsor discretion.

idea: Native consolidated family-office reporting of non-DAF assets
argue_against: Out of scope.

idea: Foundation-style signed grant agreement for every DAF grant
argue_against: No legal need for public-charity grants; heavy friction at millions of grants.
revisit_if: Counsel requires agreements for a class.

idea: Block grants to charities delinquent on a state charity registry
argue_against: Restriction binds the grantee, not the grantor; would block lawful grants.
reason_rejected: Not a legal requirement for grantors.
revisit_if: A state imposes a grantor-side duty.

idea: Mandatory grantee impact reports for all grants
argue_against: Nonprofit burden; legally needed only for ER.

idea: Build an in-house ED practice using AI
argue_against: Rev. Proc. 2017-53 requires written advice from a qualified tax practitioner; AI is not one.

idea: Universal per-grant manual charity vetting
argue_against: Routine eligibility pool is about $0.14/grant automated vs $55-$135 total cost per grant; manual vetting multiplies cost with no added legal protection under Rev. Proc. 2018-32.

idea: Require grantee receipts before closing grants
argue_against: Settlement evidence suffices; receipts risk deductible-gift confusion.

idea: Constitutional-style fair-hearing process for charity eligibility denials
argue_against: Sponsor is private with exclusive legal control; reconsideration case suffices.

idea: Use IRS TIN Matching for grant payees
argue_against: Program is for payers of 1099-reportable income (general knowledge); grants to charities are not; EIN/name match against BMF already available.
revisit_if: Sponsor pays reportable amounts (e.g. ER grants to for-profits) and counsel confirms eligibility.

idea: Adopt full bank-style KYC/CIP for donors and grantees as legal requirement
argue_against: No BSA mandate for a charity paying its own grants (RCF-REG-007).

idea: Treat WCAG conformance as a statutory obligation
argue_against: No DOJ Title III web regulation (general knowledge); keep as industry practice target.
revisit_if: DOJ issues Title III web rule.

idea: Tenant-authored code/scripting (Apex-style extensions) for sponsor-specific rules
argue_against: Executable tenant logic breaks one-system invariant, audit and §4966 control proofs.
revisit_if: Policy catalogue repeatedly cannot express a validated sponsor need.

idea: Public integration marketplace with listing, billing and revenue share
argue_against: Commerce, curation and liability; few DAF integrators.
reason_rejected: Not needed for any of the 10 models at release 1.

idea: Shared-schema row-level security as default isolation
argue_against: Single-bug cross-sponsor leak; not approved profile.
reason_rejected: Isolation between legal sponsors outweighs cost.
revisit_if: Benchmarks show db-per-sponsor uneconomic at target scale and counsel accepts RLS.

idea: Per-tenant code version pinning (tenants choose when to upgrade)
argue_against: N versions to support; violates one release.
existing_alternative: Ring rollout + config version pinning + API deprecation windows.
revisit_if: Regulator requires frozen version for a tenant.

idea: Usage-based billing engine inside Unbound
argue_against: Billing is ERP scope (RCD-013).
revisit_if: Pricing model becomes usage-based and volume justifies.

idea: Adopt Temporal/Camunda-class durable workflow engine at release 1
argue_against: Second durable store whose state must reconcile with ledger; determinism constraints on workflow code; contrary to UNB-TEC-002 minimal infrastructure.
existing_alternative: In-DB state machines + outbox + timer table (UNB-XIN-WFA-001).
reason_rejected: No orchestration need found that the in-DB approach cannot meet.
revisit_if: Cross-cell orchestration volume or >50 distinct long-running process types make in-house scheduler maintenance costly.

idea: Sponsor-authored BPMN process models
argue_against: Sponsors could remove statutory gates; executable tenant logic.
revisit_if: Never for financial gates; maybe for non-financial case checklists.

idea: Lottery-style annuitized or installment payouts to recipients
argue_against: Recurring grants already exist; annuity math irrelevant.

idea: Owner-directed transfer right modelled on HSA/IRA trustee-to-trustee transfer
argue_against: DAF donor has advisory privilege only; sponsor discretion required.

idea: Building an in-house CIAM/identity provider
argue_against: Security-critical commodity; high risk.
revisit_if: No managed IdP meets realm/step-up needs.

idea: Automatic deletion at retention expiry
argue_against: Indefensible against racing holds; REQ-X-038 forbids.
revisit_if: Counsel approves auto-disposition for low-risk classes (e.g. telemetry C4).

idea: Funds transfer pricing for cash and balances
argue_for: Would attribute balance-related economics to business units.
argue_against: No lending/deposit book; fund assets are irrevocably contributed charitable assets; a float credit would reward delayed grant payment.
existing_alternative: FI-36 owner/destination of float and in-transit interest; RevenueRecord for policy-assigned float income.
reason_rejected: Economic substrate absent; creates harmful incentive.
revisit_if: Sponsor operates a lending or credit-line product to funds.

idea: Real-time attribution of all costs (streaming cost pipeline)
argue_against: Most pools are known monthly; real-time adds infrastructure contrary to UNB-PLAT-006/UNB-TEC-002 and gives false precision.
existing_alternative: Near-real-time only for metered vendor/AI costs; monthly for pools.
revisit_if: A cost category becomes large, variable and controllable intra-month.

idea: Posting activity-based allocations to the GL or charging funds automatically
argue_against: Allocation rules change; fund charges need fee authority and disclosure; violates ledger immutability spirit.
revisit_if: Never for funds; for sponsor opex only if CPA requires.

idea: Per-donor profitability or LTV driving service level, queue priority or review depth
argue_for: Focus scarce staff on valuable relationships.
argue_against: Fiduciary and fairness concerns; compliance review depth must follow risk, not revenue; reputational harm.
revisit_if: Never for control paths; maybe for optional concierge services under explicit sponsor policy.

idea: Autonomous AI cost optimisation that changes routing, thresholds or policies
argue_against: AI cannot exercise sponsor discretion; REQ-X-042 Tier C; risk of control erosion.
revisit_if: Only Tier A non-financial UX content within existing REQ-X-042 policy.

idea: Traditional survey-based ABC with periodic employee time surveys
argue_against: Costly, subjective, abandoned in practice per Kaplan & Anderson; surveillance concerns.

idea: Keystroke/screen-time employee tracking for touch time
argue_against: Surveillance, employment-law and morale risk; per-worker data prohibited by ECO-021.

idea: Separate cost data warehouse or FinOps microservice
argue_against: Violates modular-monolith preference; duplicates read models.
existing_alternative: In-monolith projection; FOCUS-format export for external tools if desired.
revisit_if: Data volumes exceed managed DB capability.

idea: Insurance-style combined/expense ratio as headline target
argue_against: DAF has no premiums/losses; bps of AUM moves with markets; composite hides controls (REQ-X-043 rejects composite health score).

idea: Dynamic (demand-based) donor pricing, e.g. December surcharges
argue_against: Discourages charitable giving at peak; reputational and reasonableness concerns; disclosures.
existing_alternative: Giving plans and deferral windows (economic-model levers).
revisit_if: Voluntary discounts for off-peak scheduling, sponsor-approved.

idea: Erlang-C as the sole staffing model for review work
argue_against: Assumes perishable short contacts; review work carries backlog over days.
existing_alternative: Daily backlog simulation (ECO-017); Erlang-C allowed for phone contacts only.

idea: Kafka (or other) message broker as the enterprise event backbone
argue_for: Replayable fan-out, decoupled teams, high throughput
argue_against: Second durable system; dual-write problem moves to broker; volumes are 1-2 orders of magnitude below single-PostgreSQL capacity (REPORT volume table); adds ops and skills

idea: Single generic append-only event table/EventStore for all business facts
argue_against: Mixes authority classes; prevents per-class constraints and privileges; duplicates the journal

idea: External workflow engine (Temporal, Camunda) for long-running processes
argue_against: New runtime and persistence; skills; not F#-native; process state outside the transactional core
reason_rejected: Infra footprint vs modest workflow count
revisit_if: Workflow count and complexity outgrow hand-written PMs (e.g., >50 distinct long-running workflows)

idea: Full event sourcing of CRM, communications and service cases
argue_against: Erasure conflicts; upcasting cost; no replay need
revisit_if: A regulator requires replay of engagement history

idea: Change-data-capture (logical replication/Debezium) as the event source for consumers
argue_against: Row changes are not business intent; leaks internal schema as contract

idea: Separate read database (CQRS) for reporting
argue_against: Adds replication lag and second store; snapshots solve determinism
revisit_if: Reporting load measured to starve OLTP after tuning

idea: Event schemas as the public partner API
argue_against: Freezes domain model; exposes internal states

idea: PostgreSQL LISTEN/NOTIFY as the durable event bus
argue_against: Notifications not durable if no listener; payload limits
existing_alternative: Outbox polling; NOTIFY only as wake-up hint

idea: Distributed sagas across per-capability microservices for grant approval
argue_against: Reservation and hold invariants need one transaction; compensation cannot undo payments

idea: Blockchain/DLT ledger for DAF transactions
argue_against: Sponsor is sole legal controller; no multi-party trust problem; cost
revisit_if: Multi-sponsor shared settlement with no trusted operator
